methodologyNotes: Covers standalone residential home and fireproof safes and chests sold at a published US MSRP, designed to protect documents, cash, media, and valuables from fire, water, and theft. Excludes gun/long-gun safes (see gun-safes), diversion safes, wall/floor in-ground safes, and unlocked cash boxes. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. interiorVolumeCuFt is the manufacturer-advertised usable interior capacity in cubic feet. fireRatingMinutes is the rated fire-endurance time the interior stays below ~350 degrees F (paper survival); null if the model carries no fire rating. fireRatingTempF is the external furnace temperature at which that fire rating was measured, in degrees F; null if unrated. ulFireListed is a boolean: true only if the fire rating is independently UL 72 or ETL listed, false for manufacturer-claimed-only fire ratings. waterResistant is a boolean for any manufacturer or ETL water, flood, or submersion claim. waterSubmersionHrs is the rated water-submersion endurance in hours (ETL water-resistance); null if not rated. lockType is an enum: dial, electronic-keypad, biometric, key, or dual (two independent mechanisms). boltCount is the number of active (moving) locking bolts; null if not published. exteriorDimsIn is exterior height x width x depth in inches, excluding hinges/handle. weightLbs is empty (unloaded) weight in pounds. mediaRated is a boolean: true only if the safe carries a UL 72 Class 125 (or lower) rating protecting digital media/hard drives at a reduced interior temperature.

products.name: SentrySafe SFW123GDC
products.priceNote: SentrySafe Store (store.sentrysafe.com/products/sfw123gdc) lists "Regular price $286.99" for model SFW123GDC (X-Large). The manufacturer product page lists only a "$200-$400" price range, so the exact $286.99 figure is sourced from the SentrySafe Store retailer page.
products.provenance: The SentrySafe manufacturer product page (sentrysafe.com/product/SFW123GDC) confirms this is the exact model SFW123GDC — "Large Steel Fireproof Waterproof Safe with Digital Keypad" — stating 1.23 cu.ft. capacity, exterior 17.8 in H x 16.3 in W x 19.3 in D, 86.69 lb weight, Digital lock with a "dual locking system", "4 large 1-inch bolts", UL Classified 1-hour fire protection up to 1700°F, and ETL Verified water resistance up to 8 inches for up to 24 hours. The SentrySafe Store retailer page (store.sentrysafe.com/products/sfw123gdc) corroborates every one of these specs for the identical model number SFW123GDC and supplies the price: "Regular price $286.99". Because the manufacturer page lists only a "$200-$400" range, the exact price comes from the SentrySafe Store; no UL 72 Class 125 digital-media rating is claimed on either page, so mediaRated is false.

products.name: SentrySafe HD4100
products.priceNote: SentrySafe official online store (store.sentrysafe.com) lists HD4100 (Large) at "Regular price $79.99". The manufacturer product page (sentrysafe.com/product/HD4100) shows only a "Price Range: $50-$100"; the store's $79.99 is the exact sourced US price.
products.provenance: The official SentrySafe product page (sentrysafe.com/product/HD4100) confirms this exact Model HD4100 — Gray Water and Fire Safe File Cabinet — stating exterior size 14.3 in H x 15.5 in W x 13.5 in D, 0.65 cu.ft. interior capacity, 38.85 lb weight, Keyed lock, UL Classified fire protection for 1/2 hour up to 1550°F (843°C), and ETL Verified flood protection up to 72 hours. The SentrySafe official store page corroborates the identical HD4100 specs, states the fire rating verbatim as "up to 30 minutes at 1550°F" and "72 hours of full submersion," and lists the Regular price of $79.99. Both pages explicitly label the item Model/Product Number HD4100, confirming model identity (not a sibling or other-capacity variant); boltCount is not published anywhere, and there is no UL 72 Class 125 media rating, so those are null/false.

products.name: First Alert 2087F
products.priceNote: Manufacturer store (First Alert Safes) lists "Model 2087F" at Regular price "$249.00 USD" on firstalertsafes.com/products/2087f; used as US MSRP. A Walmart third-party listing showed $333.93 (out of stock) and was not used.
products.provenance: The First Alert Safes manufacturer store product page confirms this exact unit as "Model 2087F": 0.94-cubic-foot capacity, fire-resistant "up to 1,700 degrees F for up to 1 hour," "UL Rated Fire Safe," waterproof seal that keeps contents dry "even when safe is submerged in water," and a "Mechanical Combination Lock w/ Emergency Access Override Key," listed at Regular price $249.00 USD. The Walmart listing for the same "First Alert 2087F ... 0.94 Cubic-ft" independently corroborates the 0.94-cu-ft capacity, the 1700 degrees F / 1-hour fire rating, the submersion-waterproof claim, and states "Four live-locking door bolts" plus the emergency override key. Exterior dimensions and empty weight were not stated verbatim on either fetched page for this exact model, so both were left null; fireRatingMinutes reflects the stated "1 hour" and boltCount reflects the stated "Four."

products.name: Honeywell 1104
products.priceNote: US MSRP $369.95 — sourced verbatim from HoneywellStore.com (operated under license by Honeywell International), shown as the regular/strikethrough price for Model 1104 ("Price: $259.95 $369.95, You Save: $110.00 (29% Off)"). The manufacturer page (honeywellsafes.com) displays $0.00 (not sold direct). Third-party SafeandVaultStore.com lists it at $195.99.
products.provenance: The official Honeywell Safes manufacturer page (honeywellsafes.com) for the Large Fire & Water Security Chest Model 1104 confirmed the exact model and stated verbatim: 0.39 cu ft interior, UL Certified 60-minute fireproof protection up to 1700°F, certified 100-hour waterproof protection when submerged to 1 meter, a privacy key lock with two entry keys, exterior dimensions 7.32 in H x 19.96 in W x 17.17 in D, and 54.3 lb weight. The HoneywellStore.com retailer page (operated under license by Honeywell) corroborated the identical model — MPN 1104, UPC 814113011040, 0.39 cu ft, 1-hour UL fire protection to 1700°F, key lock — and provided the price, listing the regular MSRP as $369.95 (currently discounted to $259.95). No release year was published on any fetched page, so releaseDate is null; boltCount is null because only compression/side latches (not a published locking-bolt count) are described, and mediaRated is false as the chest carries no UL 72 Class 125 digital-media rating.

products.name: Barska AX13496 Biometric Fireproof Safe
products.priceNote: Barska official store (shop.barska.com) lists the AX13496 at $926.99; WebstaurantStore lists the same MFR # AX13496 at $919.00. Using the manufacturer store price $926.99 as the US MSRP.
products.provenance: The Barska official store page confirms this is model AX13496, the 4.48 cu. ft. White Biometric Fireproof Security Safe, and lists it at $926.99 with exterior dimensions 17.3" x 21.8" x 27.6" (DxWxH), 100.77 lb weight, two solid-steel long locking bar bolts, biometric scanner plus a backup manual key (two independent mechanisms), and a manufacturer-claimed fireproof rating of 30 minutes at 1,200°F. WebstaurantStore corroborates MFR # AX13496 at 4.48 cu. ft. with 2 motorized steel bar bolts, biometric-plus-key access, and the same 30 min / 1,200°F rating, and lists it at $919.00. Neither page states any UL 72/ETL fire listing, water/submersion claim, media (Class 125) rating, or release date, so those spec values are false/null accordingly.

products.name: Steelwater AMBS-360D
products.priceNote: Walmart listing for Steelwater SWBS-360D-C (the current manufacturer SKU for this safe, formerly branded AMBS-360D / AMSWD-360) states "Current price is USD $459.00" (marked out of stock at fetch time). No live AMBS-360D-named US MSRP page was fetchable (Amazon bot-walled), so this Walmart retail price is used as the typical US price.
products.provenance: The Walmart listing for Steelwater "SWBS-360D-C" — the current manufacturer SKU for this safe — rendered the full factory spec sheet verbatim (exterior 13.75 x 19.25 x 16.75 in, 0.99 Cubic Ft interior, 115 lbs, 2 Hour fire rated at 1850°F, pre-set 4-wheel combination dial plus key lock, (2) active rectangular locking bolts) along with the price "Current price is USD $459.00" (out of stock at fetch time). Model identity to the requested "AMBS-360D" is confirmed: Amazon's US listing (ASIN B016LNH5JI) is titled "Steelwater Home Safe AMBS-360D - Combination Dial," the identical ASIN on Amazon.ca is titled "AMSWD-360," and both advertise the same dimensions/capacity/weight/fire rating as the SWBS-360D-C sheet — Steelwater simply renamed the model (its old 360 product page and the GOVX listing now redirect, and the site's current home safes are the 530 series). No fetched page claims an independent UL 72 or ETL fire, media, or water listing, so ulFireListed, waterResistant and mediaRated are false and waterSubmersionHrs is null; Amazon (both stores), Ubuy, GOVX and the manufacturer product page were all bot-walled or redirected, so no second exact-model page was fetchable and corroboration is null.

products.name: TIGERKING 2.05 Cu Ft Security Home Safe
products.priceNote: US MSRP $298.99 listed verbatim on the TIGERKING manufacturer store product page (tigerkingsafe-us.com) for the "58JJH | Touch Screen Home Safe 2.05 Cubic Feet Black". Newegg lists the same model (58JJHBlack) but shows no price (out of stock).
products.provenance: The TIGERKING manufacturer store page confirms this exact model — 58JJH, 2.05 Cu.ft, Black — with MSRP $298.99, weight 59.5 lbs, alloy-steel body, "3-sided, total 6 live-locking bolts", exterior 15.8x13x23 in (H*W*D), and a "Key & Combination Unlock Way" (dual: digital code plus master key). Neither page makes any fire, water, or media-protection claim — this is an anti-theft security safe, not a fireproof model — so those booleans are false and all fire/water/media rating figures are null.
